name: experience-learning-scan
title: Experience Layer 3.1: learning_scan — derive and persist the finding-signals cache
description: Add a learning_scan CLI that derives finding-signals through the store ports and persists them to .lattice/learning/finding-signals.json — the cache the Phase 1.5 hint loader reads. Today no command writes that cache, so advisory review hints never fire. This activates the loop. The scan is a deterministic derive+persist (it WRITES the advisory learning cache, so unlike learning_validate it is not read-only); it touches no gate, files no findings, and changes no scoring.
